FN-W133N9E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 436
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 436 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Attorney General to
investigate claims through the Consumer Interest Division of unlawful disposition of certain
consumer data under certain conditions, which could be offset by civil fines imposed not
exceeding $3,000 per violation.
